Maya (CS): Hey team — customer Priya reporting 403 on generation and embeddings calls with the same API key. They can call other endpoints (status, models) but both /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings return 403.
Priya (AcmeCorp): repro attached — curl below, response included. We were trying to migrate to service keys last week.
Priya (AcmeCorp): ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"redwood-1-large","input":"hello"}'```
Priya (AcmeCorp): Response: `{"error":{"type":"insufficient_scope","message":"missing required scope: generation.write"}}`
Maya (CS): Customer says the key was provisioned by their SSO admin connector and labeled 'service-key-migration-2026'. They didn't intentionally strip perms.
Jin (Eng): Can you paste the key's scope set from the admin console audit or the provisioning event? If it's an SSO-generated key we should check the mapping rule that converts SSO group -> scopes.
Priya (AcmeCorp): From the admin UI the key shows scopes: ["embeddings.read","rerank.read"] and no generation or embeddings.write. Seems limited.
Eric (Infra): Reproduced locally using their token, confirmed 403. From our authz logs: `authz.check: denied; missing scopes: [generation.write, embeddings.write] for principal sk_live_XXXX`
Jin (Eng): That matches. Looks like the provisioning rule only assigned read-only vector perms and rerank but omitted generation and embeddings.write. Could be a mapping terror in the SSO provisioning script — Sam can you check the connector template?
Sam (Provisioning): On it. Quick note: some orgs have a default template that sets `embeddings:read` and `rerank:read` for service accounts to limit writes. Maybe the migration job used the default template instead of the full-service template. I'll check the last-run logs.
DeployBot: audit.log: provisioning/2026-03-15T09:12:07 - provisioner=ok - template=service-default - key=sk_live_XXXX
Jin (Eng): If confirmed, fix is to reprovision the key with the correct template adding `generation.write` and `embeddings.write` (or `embeddings:*` depending on UI). We should also offer a temporary workaround: create a new API key with full runtime scopes and rotate the customer's service key.
Maya (CS): Noted. Priya — would you like us to reprovision and rotate the key for you, or do you want to do it via your SSO admin? We'll keep the old key active until rotation completes.
Priya (AcmeCorp): Please reprovision and rotate, we want minimal downtime.
Sam (Provisioning): I found the issue — migration job used `service-default` template (intentionally conservative) for keys created via the org-level API. The intended template was `service-full-inference`. I'll run a targeted reprovision for sk_live_XXXX to add the missing scopes.
Eric (Infra): After reprovisioning I'll kick a validation test against generate+embeddings and confirm no 403s. Also will add an alert when a newly created service key lacks generation scope for orgs that have used migration in the last 30d.
Jin (Eng): Also add an audit entry on the provisioning job to include the template name in the webhook so CS can see it without infra.
DeployBot: job-run: provisioning.fix/1932101234 - started by Sam - ticket=CS-4672
Sam (Provisioning): reprovisioned sk_live_XXXX -> scopes now ["generation.write","embeddings.write","rerank.write"]. Will keep old key active for 10m and then rotate.
Eric (Infra): Validation: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX' -d '{"model":"redwood-1-large","input":"test"}'` -> 200, token used, latency 120ms. Embeddings call also 200.
Priya (AcmeCorp): Confirmed from our side — both endpoints working. Thanks everyone.
Maya (CS): Closing loop — root cause: migration used conservative provisioning template that omitted write scopes for generation/embeddings. Action items: (1) Sam to fix migration job to select `service-full-inference` for migrated service keys where org setting allows; (2) Infra to add alert for newly provisioned service keys missing generation scope; (3) Product/CS to add visible template name in UI.
Jin (Eng): I'll follow up with a PR for the migration job and ping Sam for review.
Maya (CS): I'll send a summary to Priya and mark the ticket resolved once rotation finalizes. :white_check_mark:
Priya (AcmeCorp): Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround! :tada:
